baseline:
frr defaults traditional
hostname r1
log stdout
service integrated-vtysh-config
!
interface eth1
 description r1-to-client
 ip address 10.101.0.1/30
!
interface eth2
 description r1-to-r2-primary
 ip address 10.12.0.1/30
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf cost 10
!
interface eth3
 description r1-to-r3-backup
 ip address 10.13.0.1/30
 ip ospf network point-to-point
 ip ospf cost 50
!
interface lo
 ip address 10.255.1.1/32
!
router ospf
 ospf router-id 10.255.1.1
 network 10.101.0.0/30 area 0.0.0.0
 network 10.12.0.0/30 area 0.0.0.0
 network 10.13.0.0/30 area 0.0.0.0
 network 10.255.1.1/32 area 0.0.0.0
 passive-interface eth1
 passive-interface lo
!
line vty
!
